The purpose of this project is to support the municipality of Prishtina in making decisions for a greener, low-carbon, and resilient development. CAPSUS analyzed current urban and development strategies and trajectories to identify investment projects at the city and neighborhood scales. The scope of work included 1) developing low-carbon and climate-resilient urban growth analytics, and 2) supporting the identification of location-specific low-carbon and climate-resilient investments.
